description.value: Royston Roasting Company is a coffee shop in the small Vancouver Island community of Royston, situated on the South Island Highway — a key corridor for cycle tourists riding the island's eastern coast. The shop operates out of its own building and accepts both cash and credit cards, making it a convenient stop for riders. It is closed Sundays and public holidays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL (bccoffee.ca) no longer points to the business — it is now a domain-for-sale listing on Atom/Squadhelp, so it provides zero evidence about the business itself. All amenity and contact data therefore comes from OSM tags only: toilets=yes supports washrooms, internet_access=wlan is noted but cannot be confirmed without a live website. The business does not appear closed per OSM flags, and the OSM record is internally consistent for a coffee shop on South Island Highway.
concerns: The OSM website URL (http://www.bccoffee.ca/) no longer resolves to the business — bccoffee.ca is listed for sale on the Atom/Squadhelp domain marketplace. The business may have a new website or none at all; the URL should be updated or removed.
No website evidence available for any amenity claims; all non-washroom amenities remain unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating coffee shop on a major Vancouver Island cycling corridor. No evidence of closure; OSM record is consistent and well-tagged.
